must: Always provide a text label. For icon-only buttons, this can be visually hidden and provided via `aria-label`.
mustNot: Don't use a button for navigation to another page — use a Link instead.
Don't use a Danger button for actions that are reversible — use a Secondary button and rely on confirmation copy instead.
Don't use punctuation at the end of a label.
Don't place more than 1 primary button in the same view.
useInstead: Secondary button and rely on confirmation copy
